Also check whether the monthly account-wide ChatGPT data export has been requested/downloaded; request manually through ChatGPT export controls when due (watchdog cannot export automatically). ChatGPT cannot assume access to every conversation. Keep the separate 7 Jan 2027 post-trip catch-up reminder. Hirosaki Sakura Festival — Final 2027 Check

Review the latest available 2027 reports before visiting Hirosaki Park on Sunday, 25 April.

1. Popular festival food stalls and recommended specialties.
2. Actual 2027 vendor locations: black konnyaku, ginger miso oden, Dakekimi corn tempura, giant pork buns, apple pie and takoyaki.
3. Queue lengths and worthwhile stalls.
4. Cherry blossom conditions, including peak bloom and hanaikada.
5. Parking availability, congestion and evening departure reports.

Prioritise official information and recent Japanese-language visitor reports. This is a review reminder, not automated research.
